semanticKind.rationaleDe: Das Ziel verlangt selbstständig überprüfbare mathematische Rundungsleistung; es ist weder Orientierung noch Übungsabschluss, Prüfung, Struktur oder SRS.
semanticKind.rationaleEn: The goal demands independently assessable mathematical rounding; it is neither orientation, a practice endpoint, assessment, structure, nor SRS.

atomicity.authorClaim: One assessable operation: given-place nonnegative decimal school-rounding with its necessary place-value justification. Intrinsic place meaning supports this operation and does not certify whole bundled representation goals.

memory.reason: Applied place-value understanding and decision under an explicitly given rule, not rote recall of a rule or a new memorization deck.
